question: What is the meaning of emission trading in relation to life cycle assessment (lca)?
description: Emission trading in the context of Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) refers to the practice of exchanging or trading emissions allowances or credits between different entities or organizations. This concept is related to LCA as it can be used to account for emissions associated with a product or system throughout its life cycle.
